lessons.claim: The Kramers stress is T^(p) = n<F_s R> - n kT I, and leaving out the -nkT I term means it does not go to 0 at equilibrium, which gets misread as 'residual elasticity'. Whether the stress is exactly 0 at equilibrium is the golden test of the sign and prefactor conventions (for a Hookean, <RR>_eq=(kT/w0)I so it cancels exactly -- confirmed by execution, max|T|=0 to machine precision)
